universe_filter_policy.note: Real-universe membership must be justified by verified per-symbol data/provenance for the target window.

execution_realism.limitation_note: Hourly bar simulation only. Per spec the strategy uses 20s order slicing and order-book-aware impact; this implementation does NOT simulate sub-hourly 20s slicing, explicit spread, or live L2 order-book impact. Fees/funding/hourly worst-price liquidation checks and slippage proxy may be modeled, but results must not be interpreted as evidence that 20s slicing/market impact were reproduced.

provenance_caveat: Real Hyperliquid-native, node-derived (Ironflow HF, CC BY 4.0), NOT venue candleSnapshot. Real fetched/archived candles, non-synthetic.
